description: Returns TCY (ThorCoin Yeet) claimer information for a specific address. Takes the claimer's L1 address (e.g. 0x..., bc1..., ltc1...) as listed by list_tcy_claimers and returns the claims (one per asset). Use this to check an individual's TCY claims.

address.description: The THORChain address to get TCY claimer info for (thor1...)

name: get_tcy_claimer
